claims.kidText: A robot senses, thinks and acts.

support.excerpt: a robot is a machine that can sense the world around it, think about what it senses and then act
a robot as a machine that can sense, think and act by itself

claims.text: A robot is a machine that can sense, think and act.

support.excerpt: A toaster is not a robot because it does not decide anything on its own
a toaster does not decide anything, it just follows a timer

claims.text: A toaster is not a robot: it does not decide anything.

claims.kidText: A robot vacuum senses dirt and cleans.

support.excerpt: Robot vacuums sense dirt and obstacles and clean floors
robot vacuums that clean floors

claims.text: Robot vacuums sense dirt and clean floors.

support.excerpt: robot arms assemble products piece by piece
factory robot arms that build cars
Space rovers explore distant places like Mars and can drive short distances on their own
rovers that explore other planets

claims.text: Space rovers explore distant places and can drive on their own.

support.excerpt: Most robots have five main parts: a structure, sensors, actuators, a power source and a controller
Every robot needs a body or frame called the structure, sensors to notice things, actuators that move, a power source such as a battery, and a controller that decides what to do

claims.text: Robots have five main parts: structure, sensors, actuators, power source, controller.

support.excerpt: The structure is the frame or body that holds all the other parts together
a body or frame called the structure

claims.text: The structure is the frame that holds the parts together.

support.excerpt: Sensors gather information about the world, a little like our eyes and ears
Sensors work a bit like eyes and ears for a robot

claims.text: Sensors gather information, like eyes and ears.

support.excerpt: Actuators are the parts that move, such as motors that turn wheels or arms
Actuators like motors make wheels and arms move

claims.text: Actuators are the parts that move, like motors turning wheels and arms.

support.excerpt: The power source, often a battery, supplies the energy the robot needs
a power source such as a battery

claims.text: The power source, often a battery, supplies energy.

support.excerpt: The controller is the robot's computer brain: it decides what the robot should do
a controller that decides what to do

claims.text: The controller is the robot's computer brain that decides.

claims.kidText: It sends a sound we can't hear.

support.excerpt: a sound too high for people to hear
an ultrasonic sensor, which sends out a sound too high for people to hear

claims.text: An ultrasonic sensor sends a sound too high for people to hear.

support.excerpt: the sooner the echo comes back, the closer the object is
the faster the echo comes back, the closer the thing is

claims.text: The sound bounces back; the sooner the echo returns, the closer the object.

support.excerpt: Bats use echoes the same way
Bats find their way in the dark using echoes of their own calls

claims.kidText: It can measure a few meters.

support.excerpt: Measuring range: about 2 cm to 4 m
Hobby ultrasonic modules sold with this kit measure distances from 2 cm to 4 m

claims.text: Hobby ultrasonic sensors measure about 2 cm to 4 m.

support.excerpt: if an obstacle is closer than a set distance, called a threshold, it stops and turns
if the reading is less than the threshold, the robot stops

claims.text: A robot can stop when a distance reading is below a threshold.

support.excerpt: they sense, then think by comparing what they sense with their rules, then act
This sense, think, act cycle repeats

claims.text: Robots repeat a sense, think, act loop.

claims.kidText: A servo turns to an exact angle.

support.excerpt: Standard hobby servos can be positioned anywhere from 0 to 180 degrees
Most hobby servos move between 0 and 180 degrees

claims.text: A servo turns to an exact angle, usually between 0 and 180 degrees.

support.excerpt: This sensor is often used to measure distance
A distance sensor is the part of a robot that measures distance

claims.text: The distance sensor is the part that measures distance.
